title: Single Canonical Prompts Underestimate LLM Safety's Surface-Form Sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2608.02665v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A benchmark score is a measurement instrument, yet most benchmarks read each item at a single canonical surface form. We ask whether that reading is faithful: when an item's intent is held fixed and only its meaning-preserving surface form varies, does the canonical-form score estimate model behavior well, and how much of any variation is decoding/judge noise rather than signal? We instantiate this in safety, a high-stakes setting with no gold label to average toward. To avoid prior confounds, we pre-author the reformulations (refusal-free, mostly non-LLM: machine back-translation and a Matrix-Language-Frame code-switch generator) so an identical surface form reaches every model, score all responses with one human-anchored, vendor-neutral judge (Claude, kappa = 0.86 vs. human on unsafe compliance, stable across languages, cross-checked by GPT-4o), and verify intent preservation. translated_title: 单一规范提示词低估了大语言模型安全性的表层形式敏感性
translated_abstract: 基准测试分数是一种测量工具，然而大多数基准测试仅以单一的规范表层形式来读取每个条目。我们追问这种读取方式是否忠实：当一个条目的意图保持不变、仅其保持语义的表层形式发生变化时，规范形式的分数能否很好地估计模型行为？这些变化中又有多少是解码/评判噪声而非真实信号？我们在安全领域对这一问题进行实例化——这是一个没有金标准标签可供平均的高风险场景。为避免此前研究中的混淆因素，我们预先撰写了改写版本（无拒绝内容，大部分由非LLM方法生成：机器回译和一个矩阵语言框架语码转换生成器），从而确保相同的表层形式呈现给每个模型；我们使用一个以人类为锚定、供应商中立的评判者（Claude，在违规服从判断上与人类一致性 kappa = 0.86，跨语言稳定，并经GPT-4o交叉验证）为所有回复打分，并验证了意图的保持。在370个种子 × 5种表层形式 × 5个模型的实验中，没有任何单一的规范形式分数……
tldr: 该研究表明，当提示词语义意图不变而仅表层形式变化时，大语言模型的安全表现会发生显著变化，因此仅依赖单一规范形式提示词的基准测试分数会低估LLM安全性的表层形式敏感性。
en_tdlr: Single canonical prompts underestimate LLM safety's surface-form sensitivity: when item intent is held fixed and only meaning-preserving surface forms vary, model safety behavior changes substantially, meaning canonical-form benchmark scores may not faithfully estimate model behavior.
